summary: If you use delegated alert dismissal for Dependabot , dismissal requests now stay open for one year instead of one week. Reviewers have more time to respond before a request expires and has to be resubmitted.
takeaways: This change is available on github.com and will ship in GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24.
